narrative_text: Complainant reports that a break-in at commercial premises took place within MH-NAG-07 police station limits, Nagpur, between 14/02/2025 10:00 and 17/02/2025 13:42. It is stated that the accused opened it with a duplicate key, went straight to where the valuables were kept, were two or three persons, used a gas cutter, targeted an office, fled in a four-wheeler, got in through the door, wore gloves, came in a four-wheeler and struck while the premises were closed for a holiday. Enquiries with nearby residents are in progress. The dog squad was summoned to the spot.
